page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The absence of integrated GPUs and local NVMe storage represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing raw CPU allocation and network throughput over local disk speed or hardware acceleration.

Given its high vCPU count and low memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.c6t.26xlarge is designed for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. It is suitable for tasks such as high-performance web serving, batch processing, video encoding, and distributed compute clusters. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable compute performance for parallel processing tasks without the overhead of unneeded memory or local storage resources.
